chosen.title: man cycling down a street in a city
chosen.faces: side profile, cap, not looking at camera
chosen.why: Side-tracking shot of a man pedaling along a city sidewalk past a glass storefront and brick building; the whole bike and the pedal stroke are readable in the first frame. Natural light, muted palette, 16:9 1080p, no text or logos. At 0.7s the rider is clear of the foreground tree trunks with the storefront behind him; a thin trunk crosses briefly around 1.1-1.3s.

alternates.why: Low-angle rear tracking of the same rider on a city sidewalk with parked cars and office buildings; back view, no face. Reads as urban commuting but the low angle and backlight flare make the action slightly less instant than the side profile.
Two cyclists riding down a sunlit city street, seen from behind. Usable only before ~2.5s because a CHUBB sign becomes legible in the background afterwards; harsh contrast and small figures.

notes: Searched: cycling city, riding bicycle, bike commuter, woman riding bike city, bike lane, bicycle street. Downloaded 41878, 41892, 41884, 11846. 11846 (rider through a city park) is a clean rear shot but is a park path rather than a city street and only 720p, so it was dropped. Alternate in-point for 41878: 4.7s gives the cleanest unobstructed side profile against a concrete/corten wall if the storefront window is not needed. Candidate files left in assets/footage/candidates.
